candidate.definition_en: Relating to or characteristic of the countryside rather than the town.
candidate.explanation_ar: ريفي.. أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالريف والزراعة، عكس المدن.

senses.definition_en: Relating to or characteristic of the countryside rather than the town.
senses.definition_ar: متعلق بالريف أو الحياة فيه، على عكس المدينة.
examples: She lives in a peaceful rural area.
Public transport is often limited in rural communities.
The government is investing in rural development.
